purpose: Exploratory leave-one-sequence-out stability check of the whole-source utility-trained TCMN channel gate, using already frozen source-deletion reads. This follow-up is selected after examining prior results and is not independent confirmation.
folds: Five fixed folds over seq2, seq3, seq4, seq9, seq10. Each fold trains on labeled-present reads of the other four sequences and evaluates the held-out sequence only. Priority sequences 8, 11, 20, 23 never enter training. Sequence identities do not establish patient independence.
training: Same feature descriptors, label-free inputs and pairwise utility target as lean_source_utility_channel_pilot_v1. Same seed 20261114, AdamW learning rate 0.01, weight decay 0.0001, 100 full-batch steps and equal-read logistic pairwise ranking loss. No held-out-label access, checkpoint selection or tuning in each fold. Freeze predictions before reading held-out outcomes. Fit from scratch per fold and save research-only checkpoints.
evaluation: Report each held-out sequence's within-read concordance and mean paired Dice difference for the lowest-scoring deletion against the descriptive mean of the five equal-key masks. Compare uniform, occupancy-trained, RGB, shuffled and age controls; report empty-frame false alarms and selected counts. These are fixed-read diagnostics, not full-video propagation. Training data and all evaluated sequences were previously inspected, and historical pre-read Lean usage and a distributed control are unavailable in this score set.
limitations: Only 16 labeled-present and one labeled-empty eligible reads from five sequences are available. Targets are small local conditional effects and read groups are dependent. No inference promotion, untrained attention weights, confidence gate, detector call or ground-truth inference input.
